firstRun.title: Create a local identity
firstRun.intro: This identity lives on this device. No account, email, or server. The 24-word recovery phrase is the only way to restore your data.
firstRun.wordNotice: Write these 24 words somewhere safe. The phrase is shown once and is never stored in readable form.
firstRun.confirmHint: Fill in the three words below in order.
firstRun.mismatch: Words do not match. Check the phrase again.
firstRun.recoverHint: Enter the 24 words separated by spaces.
firstRun.recoverMismatch: The phrase does not match the identity on this device.
